summary: adapter.py: deterministic quick-dev TDD lifecycle adapter; repository root derived from file parents and imports strict skill_input_gate plus canonical evidence bytes; prepare requires backend.hidden_state=false, shell registry disabled, declared slice, nonempty contract_hash and validator_hash; skill-input receipt gate mandatory for prepare/execute and records context/binding hashes; states prepared->red-observed->green-observed->refactor-verified, then implementation-candidate only; RED must fail with expected_failure_id and change tests/docs only; GREEN requires RED and passing production-only changes; REFACTOR requires GREEN and passing declared production/tests/docs changes; all violations return blocked with RMAP rule IDs; final candidate is explicitly non-authoritative and authorizes nothing; resume requires exact identities and rejects failed/stale/superseded runs; stage binding validates one context/attempt per stage, matching plan/slice/run/attempt IDs, STAGE-{RED|GREEN|REFACTOR}, non-authoritative decisions, and hashes decision/capsule/context; protocol persistence validates bundle/store, containment, no symlinks/reparse points, immutable conflicts, ordered writes with decisions last, and allows specified observation artifacts; execute rejects preexisting run dir, creates new run, applies events, requires bundle/store together, persists recovery-state JSON with no authorization; ambiguity: execute creates run_dir before some validation failures, leaving directory despite blocked result.
